scenario: A retrieval assistant serves multiple teams. How do you prevent one team from receiving another team's documents?
rubric: Derive authorized principals from trusted authentication.
Apply access-control filtering during retrieval before context reaches the model.
Explain that model instructions cannot replace application authorization.
Explain the approach in a clear sequence with assumptions and an example.
misconceptions: Asking the model to hide forbidden documents makes unrestricted retrieval safe.

sources.title: Search security filters
sources.claim: Derive authorized principals from trusted authentication. Apply access-control filtering during retrieval before context reaches the model.

follow_ups.scenario: Can the client choose arbitrary security principals in the search filter?
rubric: Derive and validate principals on the trusted server boundary.
